description: This file provides database maintenance utilities for the Sports Telecast Backend project, including functions for inspecting and managing PostgreSQL locks, advisory lock management, Alembic database migrations handling, and initial schema diagnostics.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _get_lock_key_pair(key: int)
methods.description: Converts a bigint advisory lock key into PostgreSQL's internal classid and objid pairs.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] inspect_locks(engine: Engine = sync_engine)
methods.description: Inspects active PostgreSQL advisory locks and sessions that are blocked.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] clear_advisory_lock_holders(lock_key: Optional[str] = None, engine: Engine = sync_engine)
methods.description: Terminates backend sessions holding or waiting on a specific advisory lock key.

methods.name: Config _alembic_config()
methods.description: Constructs and returns an Alembic Config object pointing to the project's alembic directory.

methods.name: None alembic_reset()
methods.description: Truncates the alembic_version table to reset Alembic's current version state.

methods.name: None alembic_stamp_base()
methods.description: Sets Alembic's version to 'base' without running migrations.

methods.name: None alembic_upgrade(revision: str = "head")
methods.description: Runs Alembic upgrade command to a specified revision (default is 'head').

methods.name: bool _table_exists(conn, table_name: str)
methods.description: Checks if a specific table exists in the current database schema.

methods.name: List[str] _fetch_alembic_versions(conn)
methods.description: Fetches all version identifiers stored in the alembic_version table.

methods.name: Set[str] _initial_expected_tables()
methods.description: Returns a set of table names expected from the initial migration (001).

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _inspect_initial_schema(conn)
methods.description: Checks presence of initial migration tables and identifies missing ones.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] diagnose_initial_state(engine: Engine = sync_engine)
methods.description: Diagnoses database lock state and schema presence related to initial migration.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] repair_initial_migration(lock_key: Optional[str] = None, engine: Engine = sync_engine)
methods.description: Inspects and attempts to repair initial migration state and clear advisory locks.

ctags.name: clear_advisory_lock_holders
ctags.pattern: /^def clear_advisory_lock_holders(lock_key: Optional[str] = None, engine: Engine = sync_engine) ->/

ctags.name: repair_initial_migration
ctags.pattern: /^def repair_initial_migration(lock_key: Optional[str] = None, engine: Engine = sync_engine) -> Di/

ctags.name: sync_engine
ctags.pattern: /^from .connection import engine as sync_engine  # uses sync engine for admin ops$/
